user.title: Frost Risks
user.description: Choose one weather entity, or both temperature and humidity sensors. Individual sensors override only their corresponding weather value. Use weather for the same location as the surface. Optional rain/snow inputs must describe current precipitation, not lifetime totals. Outputs are advisory and never control a device. An interior sensor enables an uncalibrated glass model with temperature history. Heating status records end/duration only, never ice clearance. Select the relevant defrost switch, not ordinary thermostat cycles. Glass parameters are explicit reference assumptions, not Tesla calibration.
